data.text: On Thursday a real TV team came to our school. The presenter, Miss Vega, interviewed our head teacher first — he was so nervous that he said his own name wrong! Then they filmed the science room, where Maya showed her volcano experiment. The best moment was in the playground: Kili flew down and landed on the camera! Everybody laughed, and the camera operator gave him a biscuit. The report will be on channel nine on Sunday, after the eight o'clock news.

data.script: Diego: TV day checklist! The team arrives at nine o'clock. … Diego: First stop: the library. Quiet voices, please! … Diego: Then the music room — Oliver's band will play their new song, Lighthouse Nights. … Diego: Maya's interview is at eleven, next to the volcano. Don't press the red button before the cameras are ready! … Diego: Lunch with the TV team: the cook is making her famous fish soup. … Diego: And the big final: Kili flies over the playground with the school flag. … Diego: Kili, please: this time, do NOT land on the camera!
